description: A sinuous, rectilinear embankment approximately 5–10 m wide and 400 m long, visible in the hillshade as a low-relief ridge running roughly east–west. This feature exhibits subtle right-angle turns at regular intervals, characteristic of engineered canals or causeways.

A cluster of small, circular to ovoid depressions (15–20 m diameter) aligned along the southern flank of the embankment. The spacing of these depressions forms a loose grid pattern, suggestive of house-mound platforms or field-cell insets adjacent to canal systems.
